from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FixedAssetEntry(BaseModel):
    """Fixed assets reported in one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the report")
    fixed_assets: float | None = Field(description="The fixed assets amount as reported")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="Which statement this comes from, e.g., '合并资产负债表'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the fixed assets value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fixed_asset_entries: list[FixedAssetEntry]
